news.title: NebulaOS 0.6.1
news.text: First release of the NebulaOS update channel

news.title: NebulaOS 0.7.0
news.text: Updates move to NebulaOS-updates; the update address is kept on every update

news.title: NebulaOS 0.7.1
news.text: Each mode now has its own panels: Hacking like macOS, Gaming like Garuda, Server like Ubuntu

news.title: NebulaOS 0.7.2
news.text: Panels change shape and style with the mode: glass macOS dock, solid Garuda taskbar, Ubuntu side dock

news.title: NebulaOS 0.7.3
news.text: Fixed: wallpaper and panels change again, keyboard layouts are kept, languages work, Nebula Chat reconnects, the assistant knows NebulaOS

news.title: NebulaOS 0.7.4
news.text: Nebula Store installs apps right in the window with a progress bar; 100+ apps

news.title: NebulaOS 0.7.5
news.text: New macOS-style login screen, clean startup sound, plain app names and texts

news.title: NebulaOS 0.7.6
news.text: Each mode has its own window style, buttons, icons, cursor and font: macOS for Hacking, Garuda neon for Gaming, Ubuntu for Server

news.title: NebulaOS 0.7.7
news.text: New apps: Game Center, Toolkit and Server Panel; each mode styles the NebulaOS apps its own way

news.title: NebulaOS 0.7.8
news.text: New look without purple: graphite and blue for Hacking, black and red for Gaming, grey and orange for Server; calm new wallpapers

news.title: NebulaOS 0.8.0
news.text: App Store with the whole Flathub catalog (3000+ apps, screenshots, categories); space wallpapers in the colors of each mode

news.title: NebulaOS 0.8.1
news.text: Game Center like Big Picture, Server Panel with live graphs, logs and containers, Toolkit with network scan, port check and Wi-Fi list

news.title: NebulaOS 0.8.2
news.text: Fixes: window buttons visible again, icons in Server mode, panels locked, no GRUB theme error at boot, no keyboard error after updates, clearer update text

news.title: NebulaOS 0.9.0
news.text: New: Control Center (Super+C), Spotlight (Super+Space), Time Machine style Backups, Phone pairing, Screen time with limits, Drivers app, desktop widgets for each mode

news.title: NebulaOS 0.9.1
news.text: Nebula Link (phone, send links), one-click Nextcloud and Pi-hole, Lessons and Password check in Toolkit

news.title: NebulaOS 0.9.2
news.text: Game Bar (Super+G) with instant replay, Move from Windows, System restore, ProtonDB ratings in Game Center, new steps in Welcome

news.title: NebulaOS 0.9.3
news.text: Game Bar can be dragged and made transparent; jelly windows when moving; drop files and apps on the desktop, Add to desktop in the right-click menu

news.title: NebulaOS 0.9.4
news.text: Server services install themselves (Docker, SSH, Cockpit, nginx, PostgreSQL); Assistant: 10 models with recommendation and download progress; panels locked again

news.title: NebulaOS 0.9.5
news.text: Server Panel: Jellyfin, Nextcloud, Pi-hole, file server and Minecraft install in one click with progress; services install without the terminal

news.title: NebulaOS 0.9.6
news.text: New look per mode: Gaming like Steam, Hacking like Finder, Server like Ubuntu (no colored tiles or cards); new servers: Immich, Vaultwarden, Home Assistant, qBittorrent, Uptime Kuma; remote access with Tailscale
